title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-12 SGA repair025 cumulative SGA5 French diagram-disposition pass
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version keeps the current reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and compact source ZIPs, while adding the SGA5/SGA6 repair025 cumulative package as the latest SGA5 French diagram-disposition and source-indexed repair pass.

Status at a glance. This is a substantial working-draft and repair record, not a globally certified complete edition or critical edition. Repair025 carries forward the current cumulative SGA5 and SGA6 French TeX/PDF state. In this pass, SGA5 French repairs cover source pp.160, 171, 174-177, and 180, and the package includes a 484-page source-indexed SGA5 audit PDF plus a source-to-current-French-page map. SGA6 French is carried forward unchanged in repair025. SGA5 English remains an unsynchronized carry-forward branch. SGA6 dense worklist material remains open and was not touched in repair025. SGA6 and SGA7 material should still be read with explicit working-draft/compression caveats unless a specific packet declares narrower source-checked coverage.

File-surface curation note. The SGA record is at Zenodo's 100-file ceiling. This version removes the older aid-only witness package SGA5_r007_diag_aid_20260609.zip from the latest file surface in order to add sga5_sga6_repair025_cumulative_20260612.zip. The removed aid package and all previous attached packages remain preserved in earlier Zenodo versions.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, or Source-Checked are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
